message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout during dinner, and wouldn’t you know it, my friend Jess turned into a bundle of nerves. While I was digging out my trusty flashlight, she was frantically searching for her phone charger, convinced we’d be in the dark forever. I reminded her we had power banks and snacks to keep us comfy, and just like that, her panic shifted to laughter as we shared stories by flashlight. It’s funny how a little preparedness can turn a potential panic into a cozy adventure. Anyone else have a friend who’s a bit of a worrier?
